about: Lab PR 249: the encryption of ransomware-alone-engaged under the signed per-rule policy `combat-without-corroboration NN-L-IMP-001` (lab PR 236), on this case's machine only (its own policy handle): an unpackaged program of a login session renames 20 files to .locked and leaves ciphertext — RansomwareEncryption, decisive under the directive: COMBAT with nothing in its scope before, unlocked (any user can encrypt their own files: the ransomware trigger never locks COMBAT). The ladder investigates; at the deadline NEUTRALIZE kills its tree through the kill cgroup and quarantines its binary; contained, no isolation. Quiet for the window, the unlocked COMBAT decays to ENGAGED and the ladder stands down. Replayed beside the other cases, whose machines read the built-in defaults: ransomware-alone-engaged stays ENGAGED.
